q: Three partners shared the profit in a business in the ratio 5 : 7 : 8. They had partnered for 14 months, 8 months and 7 months respectively. What was the ratio of their investments?
s: Let their investments be Rs. x for 14 months, Rs. y for 8 months and Rs. z for 7 months respectively. Then, 14x : 8y : 7z = 5 : 7 : 8. Now, $$\begin{aligned} & \frac{{14x}}{{8y}} = \frac{5}{7} \Rightarrow 98x = 40y \\ & \Rightarrow y = \frac{{49x}}{{20}} \\ & {\text{And, }}\frac{{14x}}{{7z}} = \frac{5}{8} \\ & \Rightarrow 112x = 35z \\ & \Rightarrow z = \frac{{112x}}{{35}} = \frac{{16x}}{5} \\ & {\text{So}}\,x:y:z = x:\frac{{49x}}{{20}}:\frac{{16x}}{5} \\ & ({\text{Multiply by 20}}) \\ & \Rightarrow 20:49:64 \end{aligned}$$

q: Rahul and Bharti are partners in a business. Rahul contributes $$\frac{1}{4}$$th capital for 15 months and Bharti received $$\frac{2}{3}$$ of profit. For how long Bharti money was used.
s: $$\begin{aligned} & {\text{Let}}\,{\text{the}}\,{\text{total}}\,{\text{profit}}\,{\text{be}}\,Rs.\,Z \\ & {\text{Bharti's}}\,{\text{share}} = {\frac{2}{3}} Z \\ & {\text{Rahul's}}\,{\text{share}} = Z - {\frac{2}{3}} Z \\ & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\, = \frac{Z}{3} \\ & {\text{Rahul:Bharti}} \\ & = \frac{Z}{3}: {\frac{2}{3}} Z = 1:2 \\ & {\text{Now}}\,{\text{let}}\,{\text{the}}\,{\text{total}}\,{\text{capital}}\,{\text{be}}\,Rs\,X, \\ & {\text{and}}\,{\text{Bharti}}\,{\text{capital}}\,{\text{was}}\,{\text{used}}\,{\text{for}}\,Y\,{\text{months}}. \\ & {\text{then,}}\,{\text{Rahul}}\,{\text{capital}}\,{\text{will}}\,{\text{be}}\, {\frac{1}{4}} X \\ & {\text{and}}\,{\text{Bharti}}\,{\text{capital}}\,{\text{will}}\,{\text{be}}\,X - {\frac{1}{4}} X \\ & = \frac{{3X}}{4} \\ & \frac{{\frac{1}{4}X*15}}{{\frac{3}{4}X*Y}} = \frac{1}{2} \\ & Y = \frac{{15*2}}{3} = 10 \\ & {\text{So,}}\,{\text{Bharti's}}\,{\text{money}}\,{\text{was}}\,{\text{used}}\,{\text{for}}\,{\text{10}}\,{\text{months}} \end{aligned}$$

q: Two brother invested Rs. 50000 and Rs. 70000 respectively in a business and agreed that 70% of the profits should be divided equally between them and the remaining profit in the ratio of investment. If one brothers gets Rs. 90 more than the other. Find the total profit made in the business ?

Then $$\begin{aligned} & x \times \frac{{7 - 5}}{{7 + 5}} = 90 \\ & x \times \frac{1}{6} = 90 \\ & x = 540 \\ & 30\% \,{\text{of}}\,{\text{the}}\,{\text{total}}\,{\text{profit}} = 540 \\ & {\text{Total Profit}} \\ & = \frac{{540 \times 100}}{{30}} \\ & = 1800 \end{aligned}$$ Alternative From the 30% of the profit, let first partner gets x and second partner gets (x + 90) $$\begin{aligned} & x:(x + 90) = 50000:70000 \\ & x:(x + 90) = 5:7 \\ & 7x = 5x + 450 \\ & 2x = 450 \\ & x = 225 \\ & \therefore 30\% \,{\text{of}}\,{\text{the}}\,{\text{profit}} \\ & = x + {\text{x}} + 90 \\ & = 225 + 225 + 90 \\ & = 540 \\ & {\text{Total Profit}} = \frac{{540 \times 100}}{{30}} \\ & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\, = 1800 \end{aligned}$$

q: A, B and C enter into a partnership with capitals in the ratio 5 : 6 : 8. At the end of the business term, they received the profit in the ratio 5 : 3 : 12. Find the ratio of time for which they contributed their capitals ?
s: $$\begin{aligned} & {\text{Here}}\,{{\text{p}}_1}:{{\text{p}}_2}:{{\text{p}}_3} = 5:3:12 \\ & {\text{and}}\,{{\text{x}}_1}:{{\text{x}}_2}:{{\text{x}}_3} = 5:6:8 \\ & {\text{According}}\,{\text{to}}\,{\text{the}}\,{\text{formula}} \\ & {\text{Required}}\,{\text{ratio}} \\ & = \frac{{{ {\text{p}}_1}}}{{{{\text{x}}_1}}}:\frac{{{{\text{p}}_2}}}{{{{\text{x}}_2}}}:\frac{{{{\text{p}}_3}}}{{{{\text{x}}_3}}} \\ & = \frac{5}{5}:\frac{3}{6}:\frac{{12}}{8} \\ & = 1:\frac{1}{2}:\frac{3}{2} \\ & = 2:1:3 \\ & \\ & {\bf{Alternate:}} \\ & {\text{Profit}} = {\text{Time}} \times {\text{Capital invested}} \\ & {\text{Time}} = \frac{{{\text{Profit}}}}{{{\text{Capital invested}}}} \\ & {\text{Required ratio of time}} \\ & = \frac{5}{6}:\frac{3}{6}:\frac{{12}}{8} \\ & = 1:\frac{1}{2}:\frac{3}{2} \\ & = 2:1:3 \end{aligned}$$

q: A, B and C are three partners. They altogether invested Rs. 14000 in business. At the end of the year, A got Rs. 337.50, B Rs. 1125 and C Rs. 637.50 as profit. The difference between the investments of B and A was ?

q: Jhon, Mona and Gordon, three US based business partners, jointly invested in a business project to supply nuclear fuel to India. q: Anu is a working partner and Bimla is a sleeping partner in a business. Anu puts Rs. 5000 and Bimla putes in Rs. 6000. Anu receives 12.5% of the profit for managing the business and the rest is divided in proportion to their capitals. What does each get put of a profit of Rs. 880 ?

q: The ratio of investments of two partners X and Y is 11 : 12 and the ratio of their profit is 2 : 3. If X invested the money for 8 months, then the time for which Y invested the money is ?

q: A and B enter into partnership. At the end of 9 months B withdraws but A's capitals is used for one month more. If they receive profit in the ratio of 5 : 6, then the ratio of their capital is ?
s: Let A's capital = Rs. x Let B's capital = Rs. y Now, according to the question, A B Capital → x y Time (in month) → (9 + 1) = 10 9 Ratio of profit → 5 6 $$\begin{aligned} & {\text{We know,}} \\ & \frac{{10 \times x}}{{x \times y}} = \frac{5}{6} \\ & \Leftrightarrow \frac{x}{y} = \frac{3}{4} \end{aligned}$$ Hence the required ratio of capital of A and B is = 3 : 4

q: Two partners invested Rs. 125000 and Rs. 85000 respectively in a business. They distribute 60% of the profit equally and decide to distribute the remaining 40% as the interest on their capitals. If one partner received Rs. 3000 more than the other, the total profits is ?
s: $$\begin{aligned} & {\text{Let the total profit be Rs}}{\text{. }}x \\ & {\text{Then, }}60\% {\text{ of the profit}} \\ & = {\text{Rs}}{\text{.}}\left( {\frac{{60}}{{100}} \times x} \right) \\ & = {\text{Rs}}{\text{.}}\,\frac{{3x}}{5} \end{aligned}$$ From this part of the profit each gets = $${\text{Rs}}{\text{.}}\,\frac{{3x}}{{10}}$$ $$\begin{aligned} & 40\% {\text{ of total profit }} \\ & = {\text{Rs}}{\text{.}}\left( {\frac{{40}}{{100}} \times x} \right) \\ & = {\text{Rs}}{\text{.}}\,\frac{{2x}}{5} \end{aligned}$$ Now, this amount of Rs. $$\frac{2x}{5}$$ has been divided in the ratio of capitals, which is 125000 : 85000 or 25 : 17 as interests ∴ Interest on first capital $$\begin{aligned} & = {\text{ Rs}}{\text{.}}\left( {\frac{{2x}}{5} \times \frac{{25}}{{42}}} \right) \\ & {\text{ = Rs}}{\text{.}}\,\frac{{5x}}{{21}} \end{aligned}$$ Interest on second capital $$\begin{aligned} & = {\text{Rs}}{\text{.}}\left( {\frac{{2x}}{5} \times \frac{{17}}{{42}}} \right) \\ & {\text{ = Rs}}{\text{.}}\,\frac{{17x}}{{105}} \end{aligned}$$ Total money received by first partner $$\begin{aligned} & = {\text{Rs}}{\text{.}}\left( {\frac{{3x}}{{10}} + \frac{{5x}}{{21}}} \right) \\ & {\text{ = Rs}}{\text{.}}\,\frac{{113x}}{{210}}{\text{ }} \end{aligned}$$ Total money received by second partner $$\begin{aligned} & = {\text{Rs}}{\text{.}}\left( {\frac{{3x}}{{10}} + \frac{{17x}}{{105}}} \right) \\ & {\text{ = Rs}}{\text{.}}\,\frac{{97x}}{{210}} \\ & \therefore \frac{{113x}}{{210}} - \frac{{97x}}{{210}} = 3000 \\ & \Rightarrow x = 39375{\text{ }} \\ & {\text{Hence,}} \\ & {\text{Total profit Rs}}{\text{. 39375}} \end{aligned}$$

q: Nonad, Vikas and and Manav enter into a partnership. Ninad invest some amount at the beginning. q: Four milkmen rented a pasture. A grazed 15 cows for 4 months, B grazed 12 cows for 2 months, C grazed 18 cows for 6 months and D grazed 16 cows for 5 months. If A's share of rent is Rs. 1020, what is C's share of rent ?

q: A, B and C are three partners in a business. The profit share of A is $$\frac{3}{{16}}$$ of the total profit and B's share is $$\frac{1}{{4}}$$ of the total profit. If C receives Rs. 243, then the amount received by B will be ?

q: A is a active partner and B is a inactive partner in business. A puts in Rs. 5000 and B puts in Rs. 6000. A received 15% of the profit for managing the business and the rest is divided in proportion to their capitals. The amounts received by A out of the profit of Rs. 880 in all is ?

q: A, B and C are partners in a business. Their shares are in the proportion of $$\frac{1}{3}:\frac{1}{4}:\frac{1}{5}$$ . A withdraws half of his capital after 15 months and after another 15 months, a profit of Rs. 4340 is divided. The share of C is ?

q: A, B, C started a business with their investments in the ratio 1 : 3 : 5. After 4 months, A invested the same amount as before and B as well as C withdrew half of their investments. The ratio of their profits at the end of the year is ?

q: A starts business with a capital of Rs. 14000. Five months later B joins and further two months later C joins them. If the profit sharing ratio in the end of year is 4 : 3 : 2, then the money invested by C was ?

q: A, B and C enter into a partnership. A contributes one-third of the capital while B contributes as much as A and C together contribute. If the profit at the end of the year amounts to Rs. 900, what would C receive ?
s: $$\begin{aligned} & {\text{Let total capital}} = {\text{Rs}}{\text{.}}\,{\text{x}} \\ & {\text{Then, A's capital}} = {\text{Rs}}{\text{.}}\,\frac{x}{3} \end{aligned}$$ B's capital = (A + C)'s capital ⇒ 2(B's capital) B's capital = (A + B + C)'s capital = Rs. x $$\begin{aligned} & \Rightarrow {\text{B's capital}} = {\text{Rs}}{\text{.}}\frac{x}{2} \\ & \Rightarrow {\text{C's capital}} \\ & = {\text{Rs}}{\text{.}}\left[ {x - \left( {\frac{x}{3} + \frac{x}{2}} \right)} \right] \\ & = {\text{Rs}}{\text{.}}\,\frac{x}{6} \\ & \therefore {\text{A}}:{\text{B}}:{\text{C}} \\ & = \frac{x}{3}:\frac{x}{2}:\frac{x}{6} \\ & = 2:3:1 \\ & {\text{So C's share}} \\ & = {\text{Rs}}{\text{.}}\left( {900 \times \frac{1}{6}} \right) \\ & = {\text{Rs}}{\text{.}}\,{\text{150}} \end{aligned}$$

q: A and B started a business jointly. A's investment was thrice the investment of B and the period of his investment was two times the period of investment of B. If B received Rs. 4000 as profit, then their total profit is ?

q: A and B share profits and losses in a firm in the ratio of 3 : 2. And C entered in the firm as a new partner; his profit sharing ratio is $$\frac{1}{4}$$. If C has taken his share of profit from A and B in equal ratio, then the new profit shearing ratio will be ?
s: $$\begin{aligned} & {\text{Let the total share}} = {\text{200 units}} \\ & \therefore {\text{Share of C}} = 200 \times \frac{1}{4} \\ & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\, = 50{\text{ units}} \\ & {\text{Remaining share}} \\ & = \left( {200 - 50} \right) \\ & {\text{ = 150 units}} \\ & \therefore {\text{Share of A}} = \frac{{200}}{{3 + 2}} \times 3 \\ & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\, = 120{\text{ units}} \\ & {\text{Share of B}} = \frac{{200}}{{3 + 2}} \times 2 \\ & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\, = 80{\text{ units}} \end{aligned}$$ According to the question, C received equal amounts from A and B $$\begin{aligned} & \therefore {\text{A's remaining share}} \\ & = \left( {120 - 25} \right) \\ & = 95 \\ & {\text{B's remaining share}} \\ & = \left( {80 - 25} \right) \\ & = 55 \end{aligned}$$ A : B : C New Ratio → 95 : 55 : 50 19 : 11 : 10

A and B enter into a partnership with Rs. 50000 and Rs. 60000 respectively. C joins them after x months, contributing Rs. 70000 and B leaves x months before the end of the year. If they share the profit in the ratio of 20 : 18 : 21, then the value of x is = ?
s: Clearly, A invested his capital for 12 months while each one of B and C invested his capital for (12 - x) months Ratio of profits os A, B, C $$= \left( {50000 \times 12} \right)$$ : $$\left[ {60000 \times \left( {12 - x} \right)} \right]$$ : $$\left[ {70000 \times \left( {12 - x} \right)} \right]$$ $$\begin{aligned} & = 60:6\left( {12 - x} \right):7\left( {12 - x} \right) \\ & {\text{But ratio of profits}} \\ & = 20:18:21 \\ & = 60:54:63 \end{aligned}$$ $$\therefore 60:\left( {72 - 6x} \right):\left( {84 - 7x} \right)$$ = $$60$$ : $$54$$ : $$63$$ $$\begin{aligned} & {\text{So, }}72 - 6x = 54 \\ & \Rightarrow 6x = 18 \\ & \Rightarrow x = 3 \end{aligned}$$

q: Two friends P and Q started a business investing in the ratio 5 : 6. R joined them after six months investing an amount equal to that of Q's. At the end of the year, 20% profit was earned which was equal to Rs. 98000. What was the amount invested by R?
s: Let the total investment be Rs. z Then, $$\begin{aligned} & 20\% {\text{ of }}z = 98000 \\ & \Leftrightarrow z = \left( {\frac{{98000 \times 100}}{{20}}} \right) \\ & \Leftrightarrow z = 490000 \end{aligned}$$ Let the capital of P, Q and R be Rs. 5x, Rs. 6x and Rs. 6x respectively Then, $$\Leftrightarrow \left( {5x \times 12} \right)$$ + $$\left( {6x \times 12} \right)$$ + $$\left( {6x \times 6} \right)$$ &nbsp = $$490000 \times 12$$ $$\begin{aligned} & \Leftrightarrow 168x = 490000 \times 12 \\ & \Leftrightarrow x = \left( {\frac{{490000 \times 12}}{{168}}} \right) \\ & \Leftrightarrow x = 35000 \\ & \therefore {\text{R's investment}} \\ & = {\text{Rs}}{\text{. }}6x \\ & = {\text{Rs}}{\text{.}}\left( {6 \times 35000} \right) \\ & = {\text{Rs}}{\text{. 210000}} \end{aligned}$$

q: A, B and C invested their capitals in the ratio 3 : 4 : 6. However their share of profit are equal. The duration of their investments must be in the ratio ?
s: Let their investments be Rs. 3x for p months Rs. 4x for q months and Rs. 6x for r months respectively Then, $$\begin{aligned} & 3xp:4xq:6xr = 1:1:1 \\ & \Rightarrow 3p:4q:6r = 1:1:1 \\ & {\text{So,}}3p = 4q \\ & \Leftrightarrow q = \frac{{3p}}{4} \\ & {\text{And, }}4q = 6r \\ & \Leftrightarrow r = \frac{{2q}}{3} = \left( {\frac{2}{3} \times \frac{3}{4}p} \right) = \frac{p}{2} \\ & \therefore p:q:r \\ & = p:\frac{{3p}}{4}:\frac{p}{2} \\ & = 4:3:2 \end{aligned}$$

q: Swati and Rajni enter into a partnership with their capitals in the ratio 5 : 6. At the end of 7 months Swati withdraws her capital. If they receive the profit in the ratio of 5 : 9, find how long was Rajni's capital used ?
s: Suppose, Swati invested Rs. 5x for 7 months And Rajni invested Rs. 6x for y months Then, $$\begin{aligned} & \Rightarrow \frac{{5x \times 7}}{{6x \times y}} = \frac{5}{9} \\ & \Rightarrow 30y = 315 \\ & \Rightarrow y = 10\frac{1}{2} \end{aligned}$$ Hence, Rajni's capital was used for $${\text{10}}\frac{1}{2}$$ months

q: X and Y are partners in a business. X contributed $$\frac{1}{3}$$ of the capital for 9 months and Y received $$\frac{2}{5}$$ of the profit. For how long was Y's money used in the business ?
s: $$\begin{aligned} & {\text{Let the total profit be Rs}}{\text{.}}\,z \\ & {\text{Then,}} \\ & {\text{Y's share}} = {\text{Rs}}{\text{.}}\,\frac{{2z}}{5} \\ & {\text{X's share}} = {\text{Rs}}{\text{.}}\left( {z - \frac{{2z}}{5}} \right) \\ & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\, = {\text{Rs}}.\,\frac{{3z}}{5} \\ & \therefore {\text{X}}:{\text{Y}} \\ & = \frac{{3z}}{5}:\frac{{2z}}{5} \\ & = 3:2 \end{aligned}$$ Let the total capital be Rs. x and Suppose Y's money was used for y months Then, $$\begin{aligned} & \Rightarrow \frac{{\frac{1}{3}x \times 9}}{{\frac{2}{3}x \times y}} = \frac{3}{2} \\ & \Rightarrow 18x = 6xy \\ & \Rightarrow y = 3 \end{aligned}$$ Hence, Y's money was used for 3 months.

q: A and B started a business with initial investments in the respective ratio of 18 : 7. After 4 months from the start of the business, A invested Rs. 2000 more and B invested Rs. 7000 more. At the end of one year, if the profit was distributed among them in the ratio of 2 : 1 respectively, what was the total initial investment with which A and B started the business ?
s: Let the initial investment of A and B is 18x and 7x After 4 months from the start of business, A invest Rs. 2000 more for each eight months. Then total investment of A $$\begin{aligned} & = 18x \times 4 + \left( {18x + 2000} \right) \times 8 \\ & = 72x + 144x + 16000 \\ & = 216x + 16000 \end{aligned}$$ After 4 months, from the start of business, B invest Rs. 7000 more for each eight months. Total investment by B $$\begin{aligned} & = 7x \times 4 + \left( {7x + 7000} \right) \times 8 \\ & = 28x + 56x + 56000 \\ & = 84x + 56000 \end{aligned}$$ According to the question, $$\Rightarrow \frac{{216x + 16000}}{{84x + 56000}} = \frac{2}{1}$$ ⇒ 216x + 16000 = 168x + 112000 ⇒ 216x - 168x = 112000 - 16000 ⇒ 48x = 96000 ⇒ x = 2000 Total initial investment of A and B = (18 + 7) × 2000 = Rs. 50000
